text_to_image_prompt:
Output one image, aspect ratio 1:1 (approximately 1.000:1), target canvas 1254 × 1254 pixels.

Square photographic full-body character turnaround with three equal vertical panels: front view, exact left-facing 90-degree profile, direct back view with no face visible. One fictional adult Owen, age 24, with pale skin, ash-blonde center-parted curtain hair swept to the sides, gray-green eyes, slim long face, sculpted but narrow jaw, straight fine nose, soft pink lips and reserved gaze.  Same figure rotating, neutral stance, relaxed arms, complete hands, all hair and shoes visible, crowns and soles aligned on common level ground. Slender natural adult male proportions about 8.5 heads tall, long balanced legs. Wardrobe in every view: black fine turtleneck, open ivory shirt, matte black long wool coat, high-waisted slim straight black trousers and black boots. Neutral closed lips. Plain matte cool-gray studio wall and gray floor, soft cool blue-gray daylight and even fill, subtle fine film grain, real pores, fine facial hair, matte skin and real fabric weave. Photographic live-action casting reference, no stylized 3D, no wax skin, heavy retouching, strong warm tint, drama lighting, text, labels or watermark.
reproduction_note: 文字可复用构图、气质与质感，但随机采样可能改变脸部细节；未验证仅凭文字可达到近乎一致。需要严格锁脸时请同时使用此图作为身份参考。

original_prompt: Create square high-resolution FULL BODY photographic casting turnaround, precisely SAME fictional adult Owen, 24,182cm. Reference1 defines immutable head/face at all angles: preserve head front AND side nose, mouth, chin, jaw depth, ears, hairline, eye color. Reference2 only defines clothes, ignore its faces. Exactly3 equal columns left-to-right: straight FRONT with upright head gazing at eye level; true90degree LEFT-facing PROFILE with whole torso/head aligned; BACK directly away, face unseen. Same body rotating. Crowns/soles aligned at common ground level. Head to toes visible, figures fill90% height with small margin. Natural resting arms and visible hands, neutral closed lips NO smile in all views. Black fine turtleneck, ivory open shirt, matte black wool long coat, black highwaist slim straight trousers and black boots. Real male model proportions8.5 heads, slim balanced long legs, not bulky. Exact ash blonde head from reference1. Same garments and accessories in every view. No giant chest, no stretched neck, no tiny face. Plain real matte cool grey wall/floor, calm soft cool bluegrey daylight, real fabric texture and pores, gentle contact shadows, subtle grain, no glamour polish/oil/plastic/CG/anime. 70mm camera, negligible perspective, all face/body sharp. No other panels, no flatlays, no words/captions/logos/watermarks. Maximum available resolution.
